import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyCupOne
import MumfordLib.SourceComplexAlternatingCohomology

/-!
# Decomposable group/singular cup comparison

The full comparison between integral group `H²` and singular cohomology of a
compact complex torus is still open.  This file records the concrete
decomposable comparison that is available: the group cup class formed from two
singular degree-one characters has the same alternating period evaluation as
the corresponding singular cup class.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff IsMulCommutative

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {E H : Type*} {G : Type}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
  [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
  [LieGroup I ω G] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
  [CompactSpace G] [PreconnectedSpace G]

/-- The group cup class attached to two singular degree-one classes has the
same alternating evaluation on periods as their singular cup product. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroup_groupCupAlternation_period
    (c d : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)
    : letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
        FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
      letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
      letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
      letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
      letI : CommGroup (FundamentalGroup G 1) :=
        (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).toMonoidHom
          |>.commGroupOfInjective
            (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).injective
      ∀ (γ : Fin 2 → Additive (FundamentalGroup G 1)),
      groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupCharacterCupClass
          (singularFirstCohomologyCharacter (X := TopCat.of G) 1 c)
          (singularFirstCohomologyCharacter (X := TopCat.of G) 1 d))
        γ =
      compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2
        (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) 2 ![c, d])
        (fun i => compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv
          (G := G) I (γ i)) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI : CommGroup (FundamentalGroup G 1) :=
    (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).toMonoidHom
      |>.commGroupOfInjective
        (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).injective
  intro γ
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass]
  rw [compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup_period]
  simp [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  ring

/- The pointwise period comparison packages as equality of alternating maps after
   precomposing the intrinsic lattice form with the period equivalence. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroup_groupCupAlternation_map
    (c d : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)
    : letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
        FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
      letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
      letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
      letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
      letI : CommGroup (FundamentalGroup G 1) :=
        (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).toMonoidHom
          |>.commGroupOfInjective
            (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).injective
      groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupCharacterCupClass
          (singularFirstCohomologyCharacter (X := TopCat.of G) 1 c)
          (singularFirstCohomologyCharacter (X := TopCat.of G) 1 d)) =
        (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2
          (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) 2 ![c, d])).compLinearMap
          (AddEquiv.toIntLinearEquiv
            (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv (G := G) I)).toLinearMap := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI : CommGroup (FundamentalGroup G 1) :=
    (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).toMonoidHom
      |>.commGroupOfInjective
        (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).injective
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro γ
  exact compactComplexLieGroup_groupCupAlternation_period (G := G) I c d γ

end Mumford.Analytic
